2027-04-04.title: Second Sunday of Resurrection: New Sunday (Puthu Njayar)
2027-04-04.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The nations shall run to you
One heart and soul: the first community
Christ reconciles all things in himself
Thomas the apostle professes his faith
2027-04-04.verse: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!” Jesus said to him, “Have you believed because you have seen me? Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have come to believe.”

2027-04-11.title: Third Sunday of Resurrection
2027-04-11.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The Lord gives salvation to all who keep his covenant
Redemption through the blood of Christ
Jesus, the Way to the Father
2027-04-11.verse: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.”

2027-04-18.title: Fourth Sunday of Resurrection · World Prayer Day for Vocations
2027-04-18.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: God will never forget his people
God's gift cannot be bought with money
Salvation is the gift of God
Your pain will turn into joy
2027-04-18.verse: So you have pain now; but I will see you again, and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take your joy from you.

2027-04-25.title: Fifth Sunday of Resurrection (Mar Addai)
2027-04-25.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The Lord who prepares the meal
2027-04-25.verse: Jesus said to them, “Come and have breakfast.” Now none of the disciples dared to ask him, “Who are you?” because they knew it was the Lord.

2027-04-01.title: First Thursday of Resurrection
2027-04-01.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The election of the seven deacons
Jesus sends out his twelve disciples
2027-04-01.verse: Cure the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, cast out demons. You received without payment; give without payment.

2027-04-02.title: First Friday of Resurrection: the Feast of Martyrs
2027-04-02.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The prayer of Azariah in the furnace
The ancestors who bore witness by faith
2027-04-02.verse: Everyone therefore who acknowledges me before others, I also will acknowledge before my Father in heaven.

2027-04-03.title: First Saturday of Resurrection
2027-04-03.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
2027-04-03.verse: For you have died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

2027-04-05.title: Second Monday of Resurrection
2027-04-05.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The disciples recognise the Risen Christ
2027-04-05.verse: Then their eyes were opened, and they recognized him; and he vanished from their sight.

2027-04-06.title: Second Tuesday of Resurrection
2027-04-06.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
2027-04-06.verse: If you believed Moses, you would believe me, for he wrote about me.

2027-04-07.title: Second Wednesday of Resurrection
2027-04-07.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
2027-04-07.verse: They were astounded beyond measure, saying, “He has done everything well; he even makes the deaf to hear and the mute to speak.”

2027-04-08.title: Second Thursday of Resurrection
2027-04-08.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The privilege of believing in Christ and suffering for him
The faith of the Canaanite woman
2027-04-08.verse: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Let it be done for you as you wish.” And her daughter was healed instantly.

2027-04-09.title: Second Friday of Resurrection
2027-04-09.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
2027-04-09.verse: For the message about the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

2027-04-10.title: Second Saturday of Resurrection
2027-04-10.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts
2027-04-10.verse: Look at my hands and my feet; see that it is I myself. Touch me and see; for a ghost does not have flesh and bones as you see that I have.

2027-04-12.title: Third Monday of Resurrection
2027-04-12.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Be patient until the coming of the Lord
2027-04-12.verse: Keep awake therefore, for you know neither the day nor the hour.

2027-04-13.title: Third Tuesday of Resurrection
2027-04-13.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
2027-04-13.verse: Rejoice always, pray without ceasing, give thanks in all circumstances; for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for you.

2027-04-14.title: Third Wednesday of Resurrection
2027-04-14.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: To me, living is Christ and dying is gain
2027-04-14.verse: For to me, living is Christ and dying is gain.

2027-04-15.title: Third Thursday of Resurrection
2027-04-15.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
2027-04-15.verse: He woke up and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” Then the wind ceased, and there was a dead calm.

2027-04-16.title: Third Friday of Resurrection
2027-04-16.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Please your neighbour for his good
2027-04-16.verse: After looking around at all of them, he said to him, “Stretch out your hand.” He did so, and his hand was restored.

2027-04-17.title: Third Saturday of Resurrection
2027-04-17.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
2027-04-17.verse: Why do you call me ‘Lord, Lord,’ and do not do what I tell you?

2027-04-19.title: Fourth Monday of Resurrection
2027-04-19.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The parable of the wicked tenants
2027-04-19.verse: Then the owner of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son; perhaps they will respect him.’

2027-04-20.title: Fourth Tuesday of Resurrection
2027-04-20.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The life that really is life
For God all things are possible
2027-04-20.verse: But Jesus looked at them and said, “For mortals it is impossible, but for God all things are possible.”

2027-04-21.title: Fourth Wednesday of Resurrection
2027-04-21.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: A priest according to the order of Melchizedek
2027-04-21.verse: Without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but resembling the Son of God, he remains a priest forever.

2027-04-22.title: Fourth Thursday of Resurrection
2027-04-22.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Honour with the lips, and the heart far away
2027-04-22.verse: This people honors me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me;

2027-04-23.title: Fourth Friday of Resurrection
2027-04-23.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
2027-04-23.verse: Therefore it says, “Sleeper, awake! Rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

2027-04-24.title: Fourth Saturday of Resurrection · St George, Martyr (Geevarghese Sahada)
2027-04-24.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Daniel in the den of lions
James is killed; the Church prays for Peter
Whoever loses his life for my sake will find it
2027-04-24.verse: My grace is sufficient for you, for power is made perfect in weakness.

2027-04-26.title: Fifth Monday of Resurrection
2027-04-26.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Do not be surprised at the fiery ordeal
2027-04-26.verse: For just as Jonah became a sign to the people of Nineveh, so the Son of Man will be to this generation.

2027-04-27.title: Fifth Tuesday of Resurrection
2027-04-27.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Live according to the word of God
Bear fruit by the grace given
2027-04-27.verse: But be doers of the word, and not merely hearers who deceive themselves.

2027-04-28.title: Fifth Wednesday of Resurrection
2027-04-28.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Born again of water and the Spirit
2027-04-28.verse: Very truly, I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God without being born of water and Spirit.

2027-04-29.title: Fifth Thursday of Resurrection · St Catherine of Siena
2027-04-29.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Do not turn away from the living God
The giver of life to all
2027-04-29.verse: Very truly, I tell you, anyone who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and does not come under judgment, but has passed from death to life.

2027-04-30.title: Fifth Friday of Resurrection
2027-04-30.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
2027-04-30.verse: For I decided to know nothing among you except Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
